findings.title: Withdraw private evidence after explicit denial
findings.evidence: Two regression probes keep account identities/counts and prepared export/summary after permission-denied.
findings.proposedResolution: Clear protected data and share payload on confirmed permission/session/not-found responses; preserve known rows only on transient connection failure. Fence outstanding reads and exports by auth revision.

findings.title: Search race and initial loading states
findings.evidence: Held-response probe displays old account rows after text changes before debounced next request. Initial hasLoaded=false/isLoading=false renders empty; management initially exposes nil-state editor cards.
findings.proposedResolution: Invalidate on input change immediately; query/session-bound response acceptance; explicit not-requested/loading/confirmed-empty states; disable nil-state editing.

findings.title: Reader silently downgrades previously confirmed document on refresh error
findings.evidence: LegalDocumentReaderViewModel replaces known document with bundled fallback for all errors and has no request generation; generic offline wording also hides invalid-data/service errors.
findings.proposedResolution: Keep last confirmed document on transient refresh failure; use clearly labeled offline bundle only when needed; typed error and stale-request fencing.

findings.title: Long-lived owner commands and history use insufficient child session checks
findings.evidence: Parent removes navigation on ProfileAccessIdentity change, but child editor/history/exact reader guards mostly compare UID; publish/discard continue after awaits and confirmation has no captured immutable command.
findings.proposedResolution: Capture auth revision/authority and exact draft payload for commands, recheck after every await, invalidate stale callbacks. Preserve server MFA/rules; this finding does not demonstrate a server authorization bypass.

findings.title: Acknowledgement retries duplicate immutable receipts
findings.evidence: Actual isolated acceptLegalDocument calls for same user/type/version produced2 receipts. Same handler accepted active published record with null hash. Production source TS/JS matches local; actual current hashes valid.
findings.proposedResolution: Idempotent immutable acknowledgement with authoritative response recovery, backward compatible old clients/receipts, strict published version/type/hash checks. Do not rewrite historical receipts.

findings.title: Maximum text layout and duplicate reader headings
findings.evidence: Inspected UK/light and DE/dark maximum AX: truncated date/status chips, excessively narrow multi-line receipt action, oversized decorative controls; current reader repeats document title. Pinned editor bar and root tab bar consume substantial viewport.
findings.proposedResolution: Adaptive vertical fields and full-width actions/chips, fixed decorative icon sizes, compact accessible action layout, one document heading, deliberate tab-bar policy. Preserve Dynamic Type and scrolling rather than globally shrinking text.

findings.title: Management refresh reloads all documents and loses confirmed state on failure
findings.evidence: Each strict state uses pointer+version+draft query; onSaved invokes all three states. Source budget up to9 reads vs3 for one changed document. Results replace all confirmed states including failures.
findings.proposedResolution: Targeted per-type refresh, shared in-flight requests, retain safe confirmed state with separate refresh error. Measure the same scenario before claiming latency improvement.

findings.title: History current-version context and empty/retry presentation
findings.evidence: History captures active document once and compares later rows against that snapshot; no explicit confirmed-empty state and no refresh-current action. Exact immutable readers themselves validate hashes correctly.
findings.proposedResolution: Label captured comparison target precisely or refresh authoritative current version; add explicit loading/empty/error/continuation states and stale-session fencing.

findings.title: Close missing linked and device scenarios
findings.evidence: Existing ordinary UI tests pass but maximum size exposed issues. Actual Swift repository emulator cycle, historical comparison with multiple versions, translation review/provider error and physical APNs remain distinct from existing source/handler tests.
findings.proposedResolution: Add controlled SDK client fixtures and meaningful regressions when implementing; finish unique previews/confirmations/transitions and record exact physical boundaries. Do not replace these with a total test count.

findings.title: Concurrent metadata-only draft edits can silently overwrite one another
findings.evidence: Source optimistic guard compares contentHash, which excludes changeSummary. Actual isolated Rules/client SDK probe loads two snapshots; first summary edit is overwritten by stale second summary edit while both keep same content hash.
findings.proposedResolution: Add full draft revision/precondition including mutable metadata; use it for save/discard/publish and lost-response reconciliation. Preserve published content hashes and historical immutable versions.

regressionProbes.meaning: Deliberate failing expected-behavior tests reproduce findings; not a production change or a CI run. Probe source kept in ignored audit artifacts.

server.scope: Actual Auth/Firestore emulator; includes103-account legal notice fanout and evidence history/search contracts

roles.scope: Actual isolated Firestore client SDK and owner callable handlers. Organization roles have user global role; independent business role does not grant owner authority.

verification.productionRules: Readback blocked HTTP403 using existing read-only gcloud session. Isolated Rules pass is not active-rules hash proof.

evidenceFamily.scope: UK/light + DE/dark maximum accessibility account, receipt, recorded reader, filter row/menu. Other management family in this bundle failed due driver gesture.

managementFamily.scope: UK/light + DE/dark maximum accessibility management, locale reader, editor action menu, preview and Done. Selector reach is not complete pixel proof of body editing; full edit/reopen at maximum remains in implementation ledger.

largestUI.driverFailure: Original gesture started at y0.8 inside pinned Save bar; y0.55 within scroll viewport fixed same expected route. Prior failed evidence retained.

keep: Separate document management and evidence history: distinct tasks and permissions.
Strict exact-version/hash reader, published immutability, optional analytics consent separation.
Bounded history pagination and retry-safe notice fanout.
improve: Clear contextual labels and adaptive actions; remove duplicate visual headings.
Harden private cache/session lifecycle and acknowledge receipt idempotency.
Targeted document reloads; no new standalone screens needed.

boundaries.implementation: No product fixes yet; approval-stage audit only. Temporary probes are not left in active test targets.
boundaries.legalText: No actual legal document text/version/acceptance published or changed. Functional audit is not a qualified legal opinion.
